title: Entitlement Engineer
description:
Position : Entitlement Engineer

Duration : Long Term Contract

Location : Brazil, Chille, Colombia ,Costa Rica-LATM

Pay Range: $22/hr - $24/hr



Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking an IAM Engineer with strong SAP GRC Access Control expertise to support identity and access governance across Tenneco / DRiV’s SAP environments. This individual will manage and enhance SAP GRC capabilities across multiple landscapes, ensure access controls meet audit and compliance standards, and partner closely with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


Specific Responsibilities:

  • SAP GRC Administration:
  • Manage, administer, and control SAP GRC Access Control across multiple landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • GRC Configuration & Support:
  • Configure, maintain, and support SAP GRC modules, including ARA, ARM, and EAM
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and access provisioning issues
  • Workflow & Rules Management:
  • Design, configure, and maintain BRF+ rules and MSMP workflows for access requests and approvals
  • SAP Role Management:
  • Perform SAP role design, build, maintenance, and remediation across SAP systems
  • Support user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role changes in compliance with internal controls
  • SoD & Risk Management:
  • Conduct Segregation of Duties analysis, remediation, and mitigation
  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks
  • Audit & Compliance Support:
  • Provide access reports, logs, and audit evidence from SAP GRC
  • Partner with security, audit, and compliance teams during reviews and remediation efforts
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing IAM/GRC process improvements


Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)
  • Experience across multiple GRC landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles
  • SAP authorization concepts (SU24, roles, profiles)
  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience supporting large manufacturing, automotive, or global enterprise environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications
  • Experience in large, global enterprise SAP environments
  • Familiarity with additional SAP platforms and modules
  • ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori Security





**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.

Na Phibro, as pessoas são nosso maior patrimônio. Nós nos esforçamos para desenvolver uma força de trabalho diversificada que promova um ambiente onde as pessoas se sintam apoiadas em compartilhar abertamente sua criatividade e habilidades que lhes permitam ser o mais bem-sucedidas possível.   • Gerenciar o portfólio regional, revisando o mix de produtos e identificando oportunidades de lançamentos, atualizações ou descontinuações com base no ciclo de vida, desempenho e potencial de mercado.

  • Monitorar mensalmente os indicadores-chave de desempenho (volume, preço e lucratividade), propondo ajustes estratégicos conforme necessário.

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de campanhas e materiais de marketing em parceria com equipes internas e agências, incluindo conteúdos técnicos e promocionais.
  • Acompanhar o mercado e a concorrência, produzindo análises que subsidiem decisões estratégicas e oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Participar do processo de S&OP, assegurando alinhamento entre planejamento de marketing, previsão de demanda e disponibilidade de produtos.
  • Planejar e coordenar estudos de campo, testes e validações científicas, garantindo consistência técnica e conformidade regulatória.
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos com consultores, universidades e formadores de opinião (KOLs), ampliando a credibilidade técnica da marca.
  • Participar de visitas estratégicas e discussões técnicas com clientes-chave, contribuindo diretamente para decisões, relacionamento e posicionamento da marca.
  • Priorizar atividades de alto impacto, evitando envolvimento em rotinas operacionais de campo.
  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos internos durante reuniões periódicas, promovendo a capacitação contínua da equipe de vendas.

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability


O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição


  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.


Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

  • Solid understanding of software QA methodologies and Agile practices
  • Working knowledge of Test Driven Development (TDD) principles and experience contributing to TDD-based workflows
  • Experience with parallel test execution strategies and grid-based testing (Selenium Grid)

  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and pull-request-based QA review workflows

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade .

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Position Overview:

As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‑generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‑first operations, and AI‑driven decision‑making across the organization.


You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.


Responsibilities:

  • Administers day‑to‑day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
  • Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
  • Partners with cross‑functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
  • Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
  • Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
  • Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‑powered workflow automations.
  • Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‑channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
  • Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
  • Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
  • Ensures secure, least‑privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
  • Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
  • Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
  • Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
  • Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‑scaling teams.
  • Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‑to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance.


Position Requirements:

  • 4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‑level or high‑velocity environment.
  • Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.
  • Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel.


Additional Requirements:

  • Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
  • Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
  • Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
  • Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‑functional GTM operations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
  • Hands‑on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment.

title: Salesforce CRM Specialist
description:

As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey.

Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed.

Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM

title: Endpoint System Engineer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Endpoint System Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Endpoint Systems Engineer is responsible for managing and supporting endpoint platforms and tooling across customer environments within the Managed Services organization. This role focuses on endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and automation using centralized management tools. Endpoint Systems Engineers ensure endpoint health, compliance, and performance through proactive monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of tooling and processes.This role combines technical troubleshooting with platform ownership and automation, working closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders to maintain stable, secure, and well-managed endpoint environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Own the health, performance, and compliance of endpoint environments across customer environments.
  • Manage and maintain endpoint management platforms (MDM/RMM), including Intune and NinjaOne.
  • Monitor and maintain endpoint health, patching, and compliance, ensuring successful deployment and remediation of OS and application updates.
  • Investigate and resolve endpoint-related issues, including performance, configuration, and policy enforcement problems.
  • Create and manage problem investigations for recurring or complex endpoint issues.
  • Develop, test, and maintain scripts and automation (PowerShell preferred) to support endpoint management and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain integrations between endpoint management tools and other systems (e.g., ITSM, monitoring platforms).
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and support teams to resolve cross-system issues impacting endpoints.
  • Maintain endpoint configuration standards, policies, and documentation.
  • Participate in change management processes for endpoint-related updates and deployments.
  • Identify and implement improvements to endpoint management, automation, and operational processes.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting endpoint management in an MSP, enterprise IT, or similar environment.
  • Experience with endpoint management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, other MDM solutions).
  • Experience with RMM tools (e.g., NinjaOne or similar platforms).
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID device management.
  • Experience with Windows endpoint administration and lifecycle management.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills related to endpoint systems.
  • Experience with patch management processes and tools.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and structured support processes.
  • Strong scripting skills (PowerShell preferred) for automation and tooling.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Certifications such as Microsoft, endpoint management, or cloud certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Deep experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies, including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.

  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.

The Remote Senior Data Analytical Engineer will join our Analytics & Optimization team. This team member will be instrumental in implementing and maintaining sophisticated digital analytics solutions for our clients, ensuring a robust data foundation that drives strategic business decisions. You will leverage your deep technical expertise and understanding of business objectives to guide clients on best practices and implement cutting-edge tracking strategies. This role will also have the opportunity to explore and implement emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools, to enhance data collection and efficiency over time. Some of the solutions this team member will be working with on a regular basis include Adobe Launch, Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Tealium iQ. 


This is the job…


·      Providing strategic guidance on data collection architecture and implementation strategies for web, app, and marketing technology solutions, acting as a technical leader on client engagements. 

·      Ensuring that all data collection and implementation efforts are aligned with client business objectives and contribute to the delivery of accurate and actionable insights that drive measurable results.

·      Working directly with technical stakeholders to answer questions, and help troubleshoot issues.

·      Creating technical documentation for our clients on how to best implement various web analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics, as well as other marketing technologies.

·      Expertly configuring tag management systems (e.g., Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, Tealium iQ), analytics platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics) and various third-party tracking pixels (Meta, LinkedIn, etc) based on sound data collection principles and industry best practices, as part of a comprehensive data collection strategy.

·      Providing Quality Assurance (QA) of technical stakeholder deployments while thinking ahead on how to build solutions that solve common problems increasing efficiencies and improving data quality.

·      Implementing and maintaining server-side tracking solutions to enhance data accuracy, improve user privacy, and overcome browser limitations.

·      Integrating analytics platforms with other marketing and business systems (e.g., CRM, advertising platforms) using APIs to create a unified view of customer data.

·      Optimizing analytics implementations for website and application performance to ensure tracking does not negatively impact user experience.


This is you…

·      Seven or more years of progressive experience in implementing and maintaining Digital Analytics and Tag Management Systems, with a strong preference for Adobe Analytics and experience with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics. 


MUST have solid experience in Tag Management Systems including at least 5 years' experience in Adobe Launch, Tealium iQ, and Google Tag Manager.


·      Four or more years of strong foundational JavaScript experience, with the ability to read, write, and adapt to various coding styles, adapting to client’s existing codebases.

·      Proven experience in debugging analytics implementations using tools like Omnibug, Adobe Experience Cloud Debugger, BrowserStack, etc., and ideally experience with QA monitoring tools.

·      A solid understanding of and experience implementing solutions with user privacy in mind, including consent management frameworks and data minimization principles.

·      Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, quantitative, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to approach technical challenges strategically in the context of data architecture and scalability.

·      Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer


The Opportunity


We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics SaaS company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.


Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3PLs, and carriers.


They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.


The Role


Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.


What You'll Do


  • Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
  • Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
  • Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
  • Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
  • Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
  • Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR



What We're Looking For


Required:


  • 15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
  • Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
  • Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
  • Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
  • Native-level English and executive-level presence
  • Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers


You'll thrive in this role if you:


  • Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
  • Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
  • Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
  • Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain


This is not the right fit if you:

  • Come from a mid-market or non-logistics SaaS background
  • Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
  • Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
  • Have never built or managed a revenue team

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.


Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned


What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

description:

Preferred Backgrounds:

title: Operations Director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director


Introduction:

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.


This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.


Compensation:

  • $40,000-90,000 USD per year.


Duties & Responsibilities:


Permitting

  • Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
  • Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
  • Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
  • Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
  • Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.


Development Support

  • Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
  • File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.


Procurement

  • Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
  • Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
  • Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.


Transaction Support

  • Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
  • Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
  • Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.


Qualifications:

  • University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
  • Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
  • Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
  • Willing to be responsive and communicative.
  • Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST.
  • The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
  • Good attitude necessary.

title: Senior Web Manager
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads.
  • Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful.
  • Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components.
  • SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution.
  • Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.


Why Join Us:

This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA


Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company:  Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type:  Full-time

Level:  Senior / Staff

Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location


About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.


The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.


What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred; Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).


Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.


What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.


How to Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.


Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Offer Details:


Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home)

Contract Duration: 12 months

Number of Open Positions: 20


Key Qualifications

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process -

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


How to Apply?

Please send us your updated CV to with job ID: 62131 as your email subject.

  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.

description:

This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.

The Opportunity: Why GP Socials


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter

Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role


You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped


The Package: What's In It for You


Compensation:

  • Base: $1,500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Senior Bookkeeper - Analista Financeiro Sênior
description:
Downtown Engineers 

Senior Bookkeeper / Analista Financeiro Sênior

(full-time, remote)

About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our team has completed over 300 projects and designed more than 3 million square feet of built space across sectors like hospitality, retail, franchises, healthcare and more.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is looking for a Senior Bookkeeper to take full ownership of our day-to-day financial operations. As a fast-growing firm with multiple simultaneous projects and an extensive client base, we need a senior professional who brings organization, predictability and continuous process improvement to our financial routine.


This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role. We're looking for someone highly process-oriented and analytically sharp, someone who sees beyond the numbers and proactively identifies gaps, anticipates problems and builds scalable financial systems. 


You'll work directly with leadership, turning financial data into clear insights that support strategic decisions.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation: R$8.000 - R$10.000
  • Schedule aligned with New York time zone (EST)


What you’ll do


1.Financial operations & accounts receivable

  • Manage the company's full financial routine end-to-end
  • Lead Accounts Receivable control, including invoice issuance, tracking and collections
  • Actively manage aging reports and conduct structured follow-ups with clients
  • Oversee correct categorization of all expenses
  • Conduct phone-based collections with U.S. clients, maintaining a professional and firm communication style


2.Reporting & financial intelligence

  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations with high accuracy
  • Prepare and analyze financial reports, including P&L, expense reports, cash flow and forecasts
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of all financial data
  • Deliver financial insights directly to leadership to support strategic decisions


3.Process improvement & systems

  • Develop, standardize and optimize internal financial processes
  • Implement billing systems and automated reminders
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and propose continuous improvements


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Solid experience (minimum 5 years) as a Bookkeeper or in a similar financial role
  • Proven experience managing full financial cycles (AR, expenses, reconciliations)
  • Proficiency in accounting software (Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero or similar)
  • 6+ years of experience with financial reporting (P&L, aging, cash flow)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken), this role includes direct phone collections with U.S.-based clients
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets
  • Strong analytical skills and extreme attention to detail
  • Ability to manage high transaction volumes and multiple clients simultaneously


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with financial system automations and integrations
  • Background in professional services firms (engineering, architecture, consulting, etc.)
  • Experience with U.S.-based financial operations
  • Track record of structuring or scaling financial processes


Who we're looking for

  • Senior profile with a true ownership mindset over the financial area
  • Extremely organized and process-driven
  • Proactive, with the ability to anticipate problems before they escalate
  • Professional communicator, especially when handling collections
  • Comfortable working independently and making decisions
  • Focused on efficiency, standardization and continuous improvement


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interview with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
